answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making influence the square root of locked stake. An agent must forge a slashable bond to speak, and influence follows a convex curve: doubling your voice demands quadrupling total bonded stake. An ivory credential, an unstaked identity, stays silent, and splitting one fortune into a thousand clones is futile because each clone's whisper of bond yields only a whisper of voice and their summed influence grows as the square root of count. Mass identity stays cheap to mint; making it loud is superlinearly expensive. Only bonded capital can speak.
